name: prime-generator
description: A fast prime number toolkit. Generates primes up to N using the Sieve of Eratosthenes, generates the next prime after a given number, performs primality testing with Miller-Rabin (deterministic for small numbers, probabilistic for large), and factorizes integers into prime factors.
aiPromptContext: Use this block for cryptographic key generation, number theory problems, competitive programming, or educational tools requiring prime number operations.
